estimator_if_requirements_met: q_mix=sum_k a_k g_k; a_k=N_k/N; Rhat=(1/N) sum_{k,i} f(x_ki)/q_mix(x_ki)
fixed_allocation_variance: sum_k a_k^2 Var_gk[f/q_mix]/N_k; retain within-proposal and cross-kappa source-event covariance
requirements: Normalized evaluable proposal densities in common phase space
Absolute normalization of every proposal and consistent perturbative scheme
Support wherever target integrand and selection are nonzero
Independent hard sources and immutable event identities
Known unbiased weights including generation filters and decay factors
Independent pilot/closure and influence-tail checks before rate inference
forbidden_shortcuts: Resampled events counted as independent hard statistics
Pooling B100/C1000 with different PDF/alpha identities
Reusing historical acceptance after changing matching, cuts or proposal
Assuming proposal density from observed histogram frequencies
Using unknown nuisance values as zero
